projects.name: Music Distribution Platform
projects.summary: Production platform for label operations and music distribution. End-to-end designed and built with focus on stability, maintainability, and operational safety. Feature-based architecture with feature toggles enables safe iteration and prevents cascading failures. System complexity absorbed during design phase—appears simple as result of correct architectural decisions.

projects.name: Account API
projects.summary: REST API demonstrating layered architecture, separation of concerns, and state management patterns. Focus on maintainability and clear boundaries.

projects.name: Voxel Engine
projects.summary: Custom engine focused on performance optimization and data structure design for chunked world management.
